mutants.title: a mux launch handle is reintroduced as an entwurf_v2 delivery receipt transport
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/entwurf-v2-contract.ts

mutants.title: TMUX is no longer required, so a caller holding only a pane id makes a bare tmux resolve to the DEFAULT server
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-placement.ts
find: if (typeof server !== "string" || server.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: "no-tmux-context" };

mutants.title: selector validation is disabled, so a forged `-t` value reaches tmux's own parser
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-placement.ts

mutants.title: a nonzero or signalled tmux run is swallowed, so `no server running` is laundered into a fact about the pane
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-placement.ts

mutants.title: the pane-id echo-back is dropped, so tmux's rc=0 answer about ANOTHER pane is accepted as the caller's placement
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-placement.ts
find: if (paneId !== anchor) return { ok: false, reason: "anchor-mismatch" };

mutants.title: append drops -a/{end} and becomes a lowest-free-index new-window, a different verb from appending at the session end
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-placement.ts

mutants.title: a failed kill-window is reported as already-gone without proving absence, so a window that is still open reads as closed
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-placement.ts

mutants.title: context binding matches on the session id alone, so a restarted or foreign server with the same $N is accepted
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-placement.ts

mutants.title: the runtime precondition is skipped, so a window is opened onto a runtime that cannot start and the receipt looks identical to a good launch
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-launch.ts

mutants.title: the whitespace guard is dropped, so tmux re-splits a spaced runtime path and launches a truncated binary with the remainder as an argument
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-launch.ts

mutants.title: the launchability proof is moved inside the PATH loop's catch, so an unlaunchable FIRST hit is silently skipped and a later entry launches a different install than the operator's own `pi`
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-launch.ts

mutants.title: the `--` separator is dropped, so tmux takes the runtime as a shell-command string instead of exec'ing it directly
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-launch.ts

mutants.title: a window-name carrier is reintroduced into the launch argv, handing tmux's own parser a value this rail did not author
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/mux-launch.ts

mutants.title: the launch composition is imported by the delivery core, making fresh launch a dependency of entwurf_v2 delivery
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/entwurf-v2-production.ts
